ignoreValues.reason: FD-027: --sans stack falls through to system-ui on non-Apple. Inter is the first-choice face for the chosen 04b direction.
Admin portal uses the same --sans stack as Concept 04b. Inter is the first-choice face; falls through to system-ui on non-Apple.

Detector API for low-contrast accepts only the wildcard '*' as an ignore value — per-pair value strings are rejected (verified via 'npx impeccable ignores add-value low-contrast'). The specific pair this ignore exists for is --accent-2 text on --accent-soft background (resolves to #b5d3d9 on #f2f0ee in light mode at admin/styles.css:36-37, used at admin/styles.css:204, 256, 259, 318, 331, 357-358). The detector does not account for the 6% alpha teal overlay on --bg. Contrast for this pair has been manually verified against WCAG AA in both light and dark modes. Re-review required if any other admin low-contrast finding surfaces — the value is '*' but the scope is one known pair.
